purpose: Lightweight handoff for external AIs (Gemini, Claude, etc.) — attach with INVISION_CREATIVE_AI_BRIEF.md or alone for structured parsing.
tagline_domain: Photography, video, social content, and AI integrations for brands that want to be seen.

sibling_brand.name: Invision Marketing
sibling_brand.on_creative_site: purple only for partner links and brand switch; never primary UI accent

typography.service_headings: Montserrat semibold on some service/showroom pages

ux_principles: minimal copy on gallery and home scroll sections
cinematic vignette optional; avoid stock clichés

do: dark backgrounds and soft white hairline borders
green #50a12a for accents and primary CTAs
cross-link Invision Marketing for SEO/ads needs
dont: sitewide light theme or purple/blue as primary accent
long SEO walls on visual routes
position Creative as an SEO/ads shop

creative_latitude: hero video, mockup stages, film marquees, scroll chapters
showroom album layouts and trade vertical storytelling
alternating service flows with glow and capability chips
intentional light contrast bands on select home sections
home_sections_order: hero mockup stage (white, scaled client mockups)

chrome.header: fixed frosted glass pill, green nav links
chrome.footer: dark, Marketing cross-link, green contact CTA, brand switch

voice.tone: confident craft, campaign-ready, human not corporate

prompt_templates: Propose three homepage hero alternatives (visual-first): one video, one stills, one mockup stage. Section order + one-line labels only.
Design a showroom album page for [trade]: layout, grid, captions max 12 words. Dark cinematic, green accents.
Write six capability chips + 40-word description for a new service line matching Photography/Videography voice.
List 5 guardrails and 3 acceptable tweaks for adding a client logo marquee.
